rows.name:
Kisasa's favorite food is
Grilled Anchortail, mo. Eating
it gives me strength, mo.

rows.label: tlk42340111_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Everyone has favorite things, mo.
Not just food, but instruments
and works of art too, mo.

rows.label: tlk42340111_02_msg0003
rows.name: But the effect wears off quickly, mo.

rows.label: tlk42340111_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Kisasa stocks up on favorite food
before doing daily training, mo.

rows.label: tlk42340111_02_msg0005
rows.name:
If you're going on an adventure,
it's a good idea to stock up on a
large amount before you leave, mo.
